hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook that routes swaps through Euler lending vaults using a proprietary bonding curve (EulerSwap v1). On each swap, input tokens are taken from the PoolManager and deposited into an Euler vault; output tokens are withdrawn from a paired Euler vault and settled back to the PoolManager. Reverts on beforeAddLiquidity and beforeDonate to block unused v4 CLAMM positions and prevent irrecoverable donations.
